verdict.rationale: OpenCode's docs explicitly offer 'Log in with GitHub to use your Copilot account' and 'Log in with OpenAI to use your ChatGPT Plus or Pro account,' letting a developer authenticate with an existing personal subscription instead of managing provider API keys, and OpenCode Zen is noted to include a free coding model. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports specifically confirming this login flow (community comments focus on API keys/local models, not the Copilot/ChatGPT login path), and clarity on any usage limits tied to the free tier.
